<parameter name="content"># atlas

Monorepo with three services: `api/` (Go, gRPC), `web/` (React/TypeScript), `pipeline/` (Python, Airflow). Each has its own CLAUDE.md with service-specific gotchas; read it before working there.

## Conventions
- Conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, ...).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR.
- Trunk-based development: short-lived branches off main, no long-lived branches.

## Gotchas that apply repo-wide
- `api/gen/` is generated. Never hand-edit it; change the `.proto` and run `make proto`.
</parameter>

<parameter name="content"># atlas: Claude Code context layout

| Location | Mechanism | Contents | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` (root) | CLAUDE.md | Conventional commits, `make check` before PRs, trunk-based dev, pointer to service files | Org-wide guardrails that apply to every task, so always loaded; kept to a few lines. |
| `api/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | `api/gen/` is generated by `make proto`; edit `.proto`, never the output | Loads only when working in `api/`, so Go/gRPC context doesn't cost tokens for web or pipeline work. |
| `web/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | `npm test` launches real Playwright browsers; use `npm run test:unit` by default | A Claude-specific trap (slow, heavy test run) scoped to the one service it affects. |
| `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | Nested CLAUDE.md | Set `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing or testing DAGs | Without it DAGs fail to import, so the fix belongs next to the Python work. |
| `.claude/settings.json` hook (PreToolUse on Edit/Write) | Hook | Block edits to paths under `api/gen/` with a message pointing to `make proto` | The CLAUDE.md line is advisory and hand-edits are silently lost, so a deterministic block backs it up. |
| `.claude/settings.json` permissions (optional) | Permissions | Deny or ask on bare `npm test` in `web/` | Makes the Playwright trap hard to hit; skip if the CLAUDE.md note proves sufficient. |
| `incident-response` skill, distributed via a company plugin | Skill + Plugin | The 20-step runbook, with detail files for long steps | It's a repeated procedure that loads only on demand (zero cost otherwise). It's identical across all teams, so one plugin keeps a single source of truth instead of copying it into atlas. |
| `.mcp.json` (warehouse server) | MCP | Analytics warehouse connection for live SQL, using a read-only credential | Live external data needs a tool connection, not documentation. Read-only access and permission prompts limit risk. Secrets stay in env vars, not the repo. |
| `metrics` skill (optional, later) | Skill | Metric definitions, canonical tables, SQL conventions for analysts | Teaches Claude how to use the MCP well without bloating CLAUDE.md. Add once analysts report wrong queries. |
| `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | User CLAUDE.md | Personal preferences only | Keeps individual defaults out of the shared repo. |

## Deliberately not included
- No runbook text in any CLAUDE.md: 20 steps would be loaded on every session and are already owned org-wide.
- No SQL or schema docs in CLAUDE.md: they belong in the MCP and an optional skill.
- No restating of things Claude already knows (Go, React, Airflow basics, how to run git).
- No subagents: nothing here needs isolated context yet. Revisit if warehouse exploration gets noisy.

## Verification
- Hook: attempt an edit in `api/gen/` and confirm it is blocked.
- Skill: confirm it activates on phrasings like "walk me through the incident runbook", "we have a sev1", "start incident response".
- MCP: confirm a metrics question runs a read-only query and that writes are rejected.
- Nested files: confirm each loads only when working in its directory.
